message.content: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo cites the same fact\u2014four amendments since 2022\u2014as both a strength (evidence of lender engagement/compliance) and a risk (possible covenant/operational complexity).", "It claims the security package already includes deposit account controls and IP security agreements, yet lists those items as post-closing deliverables (due in 65 and 45 days), implying they are not yet in place."]}
